logic: S_PGR and S_PKA and S_BMP_SMAD and not S_IL1_SIGNALING
hypothesis: BMP/SMAD pathway activity is necessary for hormone-induced stromal decidualization.
evidence: ET-013 (SMAD1/5 siRNA impairs decidualization; BMP2 rescue); ET-004 (mouse Bmp2 requirement); ET-008
discriminating_readouts: PRL and IGFBP-1 fall under confirmed BMP receptor inhibition (pSMAD1/5/8 down).

logic: S_PGR and S_PKA and not S_IL1_SIGNALING
hypothesis: Progesterone- and cAMP-responsive pathways maintain decidualization despite BMP inhibition (candidate mediators such as PGR-SOX4-FOXO1 are not encoded).
discriminating_readouts: PRL and IGFBP-1 maintained under confirmed BMP receptor inhibition. Residual differentiation would not by itself establish the mediator.

hypothesis: Progesterone suppresses epithelial proliferation through stromal HAND2 and a stromal paracrine mitogenic signal (v0.5.2 change C5).
discriminating_readouts: Ki67/EdU rise after stromal HAND2 knockdown under hormone treatment; fall when the paracrine route is blocked during E2 priming.

logic: IN_E2 and S_PARACRINE_MITOGEN and not S_HAND2
hypothesis: Legacy v0.5.1 representation: the relay plus a direct HAND2 term. Same composed Boolean function as Q2_stromal_relay; differs only in transient dynamics.
evidence: Prototype v0.5.1 -> v0.5.2 (docs/v052_paep_hand2_cleanup.md); no paper supports a direct epithelial HAND2 edge
discriminating_readouts: None at steady state (identical composed function); transient decline of proliferation after progestin onset.

hypothesis: Epithelial-autonomous explanation: epithelial PGR activity suppresses E2-driven proliferation without stromal mediation.
evidence: No primary paper in the corpus supports an epithelial-autonomous route; included as the alternative the grant requires (Q2).
discriminating_readouts: Ki67/EdU stay low after stromal HAND2 knockdown; paracrine-route block during E2 priming leaves proliferation unchanged.

hypothesis: IL-1beta impairs decidualization without depleting stromal PGR activity (route unresolved).
discriminating_readouts: pSMAD1/5/8 and epithelial Ki67/EdU unchanged by IL-1beta under hormone treatment.

hypothesis: IL-1beta additionally depletes stromal PGR activity, which removes HAND2 and BMP2/SMAD support and releases the stromal paracrine mitogen.
evidence: ET-015 (PR depletion in human ESC); ET-012 (IL-1beta dysregulates epithelial proliferation via stroma); ET-017 (non-endometrial plausibility)
discriminating_readouts: pSMAD1/5/8 falls and epithelial Ki67/EdU rises under IL-1beta with hormone treatment.
